## PF Config
All settings for the Participant follow-up (mock) workflows. Other PF workflows call this one and read the result. Change values only in **Build Config**.

`mockMode: true` keeps the safety guard on: emails only to aniol.moner+*@n8n.io, DMs only to Aniol, never a live Tremendous order.
